messages:
Asha: Huge shoutout to @Tom and @Leila for the pop-up debug party yesterday. Saved the client call ":relieved:"
Tom: lol team hustle. @Ben's quick patch was the real MVP.
Leila: Coffee + whiteboard + sticky notes = magic. Also found the missing dongle in the plant pot ":seedling:"
Ben: That dongle was playing hide-and-seek. Also thanks to ops-bot for the alert that pointed us to the right pod.
ops-bot: Alert: pod-frontend-012 restarted automatically at 23:48 UTC. No further action required.
Asha: Sending a virtual box of cookies to the crew. Real cookies next week if you're in the office :cookie:
Tom: I accept the cookie bounty. Can we start a tiny ritual: "first-toast-of-demo" coffee station? :coffee:
Leila: 100% yes. Also quick poll: who wants branded stickers at the desk? React with :star: if yes.
Ben: :star:  Thanks team, felt great to jump in and help.
